Portal Administrator User Guide & Workflow Manual

Comprehensive operations walkthrough for all portal features, hardware RFID stations, document generation, and candidate lifecycles.

Production v807 Standard
Quick Jump: 1. Dashboard & Telemetry 2. Applications & Auto-Approval 3. RFID Attendance & Hardware 4. Technical Diary & Form-4 5. Request Management 6. Batch & POS Requisition 7. Document Hub & Digital Seals
Module 1
Executive Dashboard & Multi-Category Telemetry

The main dashboard displays real-time statistics aggregated from Google Sheets and live RFID scanner logs across four candidate tiers:

Student Interns
College students pursuing B.E., B.Tech, or Arts/Science with semester, department, and academic duration tracking.
Faculty Trainees
College teaching faculty and professors undergoing institutional research immersion and industrial development.
Corporate Employees
Working professionals sent by partner enterprises with corporate GSTIN and official sponsorship tracking.
Apprentice Trainees
Vocational candidates (ITI/Diploma) undergoing hands-on practical shop-floor training (online enrollment currently on hold).
Module 2
Application Review & One-Click Multi-Document Auto-Dispatch

When an administrator selects pending candidates and clicks "Approve Application", the portal executes the following automated pipeline:

Automated Document Bundle Generation:
  1. Official Application Form (Form-1): Stamped with authentic 45-degree corner seal over the candidate photo, Code 128 registration barcode, and verification QR code.
  2. Offer Letter: Formatted with intelligent salutations (Dr., Mr., Ms.) and role-tailored terms.
  3. Joining Order & Induction Letter: Full reporting instructions, mandatory checklist, and slot allocation.
  4. Digital Identity Card: Generated PDF card with passport photo, RFID tag, and scan-to-verify URL.
Automated Welcome Dispatch & RFID Assignment:
  1. RFID Auto-Allocation: Allocates an available card from the hardware inventory pool and updates the master database.
  2. Email Dispatch: Instantly sends an HTML welcome email with portal credentials and attached PDFs to the candidate's verified Gmail address.
  3. Database Ledger: Moves application from Pending to Approved in the Registrations sheet.
Module 3
RFID Hardware Scanners & Automated Attendance Management

Workstation hardware scanners connect via USB or Network to capture instant RFID card punches:

  • Shift Timings: Default Regular Shift is calibrated from 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM. Shift exceptions can be configured in Settings > Time Slots.
  • Punch Recording: Morning first tap records Check-In timestamp; evening tap records Check-Out timestamp.
  • Attendance Telemetry: Evaluates punch timestamps against grace windows to mark Present, Late Arrival, Half-Day, or Absent.
  • RFID Card Labels: Admins can print physical RFID barcode sticker labels formatted for standard thermal label printers.
Module 4
Daily Technical Diary Review & Form-4 Performance Synchronization

Candidates log their technical tasks, circuits designed, and equipment handled daily from the Student Portal:

  • Review Modal: In Student Diary, click any student to review their daily logs, hours spent, and mentor rating.
  • Form-4 Export: Consolidated Attendance & Diary logs are combined into the official Form-4 report for university audit.
  • Attendance & Diary Lock Toggle: Admins can lock or unlock access to attendance and diary submission per student or batch.
Module 5
Request Management: Leaves, On-Duty (OD), WFH & Profile Updates

All candidate requests submitted from the portal appear in the Request Management center with live badge counts:

Request TypeDescription & WorkflowAction
Leave Request Candidate requests leave for medical or personal emergencies. Click Approve or Reject. Approving marks attendance as Approved Leave.
On-Duty (OD) College symposiums, university exams, or external workshops. Approving marks day as OD (counts toward 100% attendance tenure).
Work from Home (WFH) Remote firmware coding or simulation tasks. Approving marks day as WFH with mandatory daily diary submission.
Profile Photo Update Candidate uploads a new crop/photo for ID card or certificate. Review photo preview; clicking Approve replaces photo across all master sheets.
Module 6
Batch Management & Material Requisition (POS) System

Organize candidates into training cohorts and track issued electronic components:

  • Batch Creation: Select batch category (Student, Faculty, or Corporate Employee) with auto-suggested naming (e.g. Faculty Batch 1, Corporate Batch 1).
  • Hardware Handover Clearance: Track lab components (e.g. ESP32, Arduino, Relay Boards, Sensors) issued to trainees. Trainees cannot receive completion certificates until all components are returned.
Module 7
Document Generation Hub: Digital Seals, Salutations & Verification

Generate official documents individually or in batches with enterprise security standards:

Category Filter:

Use the category dropdown in Single Mode to isolate Student Interns, Faculty Trainees, or Corporate Employees instantly without scrolling through entire master lists.

Intelligent Salutations:

System automatically applies Dr. for PhD holders, Ms. for female candidates, and Mr. for male candidates across all certificates and forms.

Framed Photo & Seals:

Template 2 Certificates feature a crisp 1.5pt solid bordered frame with white padding. Application forms feature a genuine 45-degree company corner seal over the photo.
